examples.zh: 当太阳在在东京落下时，在一座横跨意大利面条似的铁路线的桥上，另一事件正要到达它的巅峰。

roots.meaning: 向/到(ad- 同化, c 前)

translations: 行为，行动；法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势

examples.en: The company acted correctly in sacking him.
examples.zh: 公司解雇他做得对。

examples.en: The jury decided that Walker had acted in self-defence.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定沃克的行为属于自卫。

examples.zh: 只有足够多的民众起来要求，政客们才会采取行动。

examples.en: I first started acting when I was 12 years old.
examples.zh: 我12岁开始演戏。

examples.en: The movie is very well acted.
examples.zh: 这部影片演得非常好。

roots.meaning: 向/到(ad- 同化, c 前)

translations: 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节

examples.en: The government must take action (=  do something  ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
examples.zh: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

examples.en: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (=  doing the things she had planned  ) .
examples.zh: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

examples.en: Ambulance crews are ready to spring into action (=  suddenly start doing something  ) if anything goes wrong during the race.
examples.zh: 救护车急救人员随时准备出动，以应对比赛期间发生的意外。

roots.meaning: 向/到(ad- 同化, c 前)

translations: 积极的；活跃的；主动的；有效的；现役的

phrases.translation: 积极的作用；能动部分，主动部分

examples.en: games for active youngsters
examples.zh: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

examples.en: She's over 80, but is still very active.
examples.zh: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

examples.en: He mows lawns and gardens for half a dozen clients in Grafton, some of them family friends. And he is an active volunteer firefighter.
examples.zh: 他为格拉夫顿六户人家修剪草坪和花园，他们中一些是父母的朋友，此外他还是个积极的义务消防员。

phrases.translation: 身体活动，体育活动；体力活动

examples.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
examples.zh: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

examples.en: fund-raising activities
examples.zh: 筹款活动

examples.en: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
examples.zh: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

phrases.translation: 最佳男主角；最佳男演员

examples.en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
examples.zh: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

examples.en: a promising young actor
examples.zh: 大有前途的年轻演员

examples.en: He won the best actor award.
examples.zh: 他获得最佳男演员奖。

examples.en: She's not only a great dramatic actress but she's also very funny.
examples.zh: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

examples.en: As an actress she has graduated from small roles to more substantial parts.
examples.zh: 作为演员，她从配角演起，慢慢地开始出演比较重要的角色。

examples.en: The actress was guest of honour (= the most important guest ) at the launch.
examples.zh: 这位女演员是首发式上的贵宾。

roots.meaning: 向/到(ad- 同化, c 前)

translations: 真实的，实际的；现行的，目前的

examples.en: I'm not joking. Those were his actual words.
examples.zh: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

examples.en: I know Germany won, but I can't tell you the actual score.
examples.zh: 我知道德国队胜了，但我不知道确切的比分。

examples.en: Interest is only charged on the actual amount borrowed.
examples.zh: 利息只按实际借款额收取。

examples.en: I've known Barbara for years. Since we were babies, actually.
examples.zh: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了，实际上我们从小就认识。

examples.en: Actually, on second thoughts, I don't think I want to go out tonight.
examples.zh: 其实再想想，我今晚不打算出去了。

examples.en: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
examples.zh: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

translations: 严重的，[医] 急性的；敏锐的；激烈的；尖声的

phrases.translation: 严重急性呼吸系统综合症

examples.en: Young children have a particularly acute sense of smell.
examples.zh: 幼儿的嗅觉特别灵敏。

examples.en: The housing shortage is more acute than first thought.
examples.zh: 住房短缺情况比一开始想的要严重。

examples.en: Cats have a very acute sense of hearing (= very good, so that they can hear even the smallest sound ) .
examples.zh: 猫的听觉非常敏锐。

roots.meaning: 向/到(ad- 同化, c 前)

phrases.translation: (局末平分后)发球占先(先得一分)

examples.en: She replied to a lonely hearts ad she spotted in the New York Times.
examples.zh: 她回复了在《纽约时报》上看到的一则求友广告。

examples.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
examples.zh: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

examples.en: All living organisms have to adapt to changes in environmental conditions.
examples.zh: 一切生物都要适应环境条件的变化。

translations: 适应；改编；改编本，改写本

examples.en: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
examples.zh: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

phrases.translation: 增加价值；附加价值；添加值

examples.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
examples.zh: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

examples.en: Add a crushed clove of garlic (= single section of it ).
examples.zh: 加一瓣压碎的大蒜。

examples.en: In cooking, vinegar can be used alone or to add flavor without calories to our food, but what will it do if we use it on our hair?
examples.zh: 在烹饪中，醋可以单独食用，也可以用作食物调味料不附加任何卡路里，但如果我们把它涂抹到头发上呢？

translations: 沉溺于某种（尤其是不良的）嗜好的；入了迷的，上了瘾的

examples.en: Many of the women are addicted to heroin and cocaine.
examples.zh: 这些妇女中的很多吸食海洛因和可卡因成瘾。

examples.en: She helped him fight his drug addiction.
examples.zh: 她帮助了他对抗自己的毒瘾。

translations: 添加；[数] 加法；增加物

examples.en: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
examples.zh: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

examples.en: In addition to the tractor, we have acquired a new rice transplanter.
examples.zh: 除了拖拉机， 我们又添了一台插秧机。

examples.en: In addition to fulfilling the traditional roles of caregiver and homemaker, many Orthodox women also assume the role of primary breadwinner so their husbands can pursue religious studies full time.
examples.zh: 除了要践行传统的照料者和主妇角色，许多东正教女性也要承担起养家的责任以便她们的丈夫可以全身心进行宗教研究。

examples.en: Additional information can be obtained from the centre.
examples.zh: 可以从中心获取更多信息。

translations: 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；与…说话；提出；处理
地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧；称呼

phrases.translation: 家庭住址；标识地址；内部地址

examples.en: The address is 2025 M Street, NW, Washington, DC, 20036.
examples.zh: 地址是华盛顿哥伦比亚特区，华盛顿西北，M街2025号，邮编20036。

examples.en: Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope (=  with your address on it so it can be sent back to you  ) .
examples.zh: 寄上一个贴好邮票的、写有回邮地址的信封。

examples.en: President Bush gave the commencement address today at the University of Notre Dame.
examples.zh: 布什总统今天在巴黎圣母院大学发表了毕业典礼演说。

phrases.translation: 胜任……的；对……是足够的；适合……的

examples.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
examples.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

examples.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
examples.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

examples.en: The standard of his work is barely adequate .
examples.zh: 他的工作水准勉强合格。

examples.en: In “the black cat” the adjective “black”modifies the noun “cat”.
examples.zh: 在“那只黑猫”中，形容词“黑的”修饰名词“猫”。

examples.en: The "me" circuit hummed not only when they thought whether a particular adjective described themselves, but also when they considered whether it described their mother.
examples.zh: “我”神经回路不仅当他们想到一个特定形容词是否描述自我时接通，而且当他们思考该词是否形容自己母亲时也同样。

examples.en: Using phrases like “Darwinian selection” or “Darwinian evolution” implies there must be another kind of evolution at work, a process that can be described with another adjective.
examples.zh: 使用“达尔文选择”或“达尔文进化论”这样的短语意味着工作中必须有另一种进化形式，一种可以用另一个形容词来描述的过程。

examples.en: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
examples.zh: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

examples.en: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
examples.zh: 尝尝汤的味道，然后调整佐料用量。

examples.en: If your employment status changes, your tax code will be adjusted accordingly.
examples.zh: 如果就业状况改变，你的免税代码也会作相应调整。

phrases.translation: 结构调整，薪级结构调整

examples.en: a period of adjustment
examples.zh: 一段调整期

examples.en: The dynamic of the market demands constant change and adjustment.
examples.zh: 市场的动力要求有不断的变化和调整。

translations: 管理；行政；实施；行政机构

phrases.translation: ◎(法律、惩罚等的)施行，执行，实行，实施；(药的)服用；用法；给与；(庄严的誓言或诺言的)提出，宣誓
公共行政；公共管理；行政管理

examples.en: We're looking for someone with experience in administration.
examples.zh: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

examples.en: The health service spends too much on administration.
examples.zh: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

examples.en: a progressive administration
examples.zh: 进步的政府

phrases.translation: 办公室，行政管理办公室

examples.en: The job is mainly administrative.
examples.zh: 这份工作主要是行政方面的。

translations: 令人钦佩的；极好的；值得赞扬的

examples.en: an admirable achievement
examples.zh: 令人钦佩的成就

examples.en: Daniel gazed at her in admiration .
examples.zh: 丹尼尔用爱慕的眼神注视着她。

examples.en: The two men were a mutual admiration society , gushing about how much they were learning from each other.
examples.zh: 两个男人互相吹捧，盛赞对方让自己受益匪浅。

examples.en: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
examples.zh: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

translations: 准许进(加)入；入场费；承认
承认；入场费；进入许可；坦白；录用

examples.zh: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

examples.en: Were you just trying to trap her into making some admission?
examples.zh: 你仅仅是在试图诱骗她招供吗？

examples.en: Admission is free for children under 9.
examples.zh: 九岁以下儿童免费入场。

examples.zh: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

examples.en: I must admit , I didn't actually do anything to help her.
examples.zh: 我必须承认，实际上我并没有帮她什么忙。

examples.en: Admit it! I'm right, aren't I?
examples.zh: 承认吧！我对了，是不是？

examples.en: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
examples.zh: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

examples.en: It is important that an adolescent boy should have an adult in whom he can confide.
examples.zh: 一个青春期男孩应该有一个他能倾吐心声的成年人，这是很重要的。

translations: 采取；接受；收养；正式通过

examples.en: Sally was adopted when she was four.
examples.zh: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

examples.en: The couple are unable to have children of their own, but hope to adopt.
examples.zh: 那对夫妇自己无法生育，但希望领养孩子。

examples.en: He decided to adopt a different approach and teach the Bible through story-telling.
examples.zh: 他决定采用一种不同的方法，通过讲故事来教授《圣经》。

examples.en: Betty adores her grandchildren.
examples.zh: 贝蒂非常宠爱孙辈。

examples.en: Some children find it difficult to talk to adults.
examples.zh: 一些孩子觉得与大人很难谈得来。

examples.en: an adult lion
examples.zh: 一头成年的狮子

examples.en: the adult population
examples.zh: 成年人口

examples.en: He lived most of his adult life in Scotland.
examples.zh: 他成年后大部分时间住在苏格兰。

translations: 提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前

phrases.translation: 随着…的增加；随着(时间)的推移

examples.zh: 我要先提醒你，我跳舞不是很好。

examples.zh: 对你的帮助预先表示万分感谢。

examples.en: Could you distribute copies well in advance of the meeting?
examples.zh: 开会前把复印件早早分发下去，好吗？

examples.en: A line of US tanks slowly advanced.
examples.zh: 一列美军坦克缓缓前进。

examples.en: a major advance
examples.zh: 一项重大进展

examples.en: the advances made in the understanding of mental handicap
examples.zh: 在了解智障方面取得的进步

examples.zh: 他们对要视察哪座大楼通常不作事先通知。

examples.zh: 高级程度的英语学习者

examples.en: advanced physics
examples.zh: 高等物理（学）

examples.en: advanced weapon systems
examples.zh: 先进的武器系统

examples.en: advanced technology
examples.zh: 先进的技术

examples.en: high levels of unemployment in the advanced industrial societies
examples.zh: 发达工业社会中的高失业率

examples.en: career advancement
examples.zh: 职业发展

examples.en: advancements in science
examples.zh: 科学进步

examples.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
examples.zh: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

examples.en: It might be to your advantage (=  it might help you  ) to take a computer course of some kind.
examples.zh: 上一门计算机课程可能对你有利。

examples.zh: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

translations: 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动

examples.en: Come on – where's your sense of adventure?
examples.zh: 来吧——你的冒险精神哪里去了？

examples.en: But Jules was not eager for classroom learning, he hungered for adventure.
examples.zh: 但是朱尔斯并不热衷于课堂学习，他渴望冒险。

examples.en: Will you please compare the adverb “well”?
examples.zh: 请你说出副词“well”的原级、比较级和最高级好吗?

examples.en: In the class, the professor taught the students how to use an adverb in the sentence.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，教授教学生们如何在一个句子里用副词。

examples.en: For our purposes, we get the definition of a word as well as its pronunciation and type (for example, adjective, noun, verb, adverb).
examples.zh: 我们这里只涉及到词汇的定义、音标和词性（如形容词、名词、动词、副词等）。

examples.en: his courage in the face of adversity
examples.zh: 他面对逆境的勇气

examples.en: They had to struggle against all kinds of adversity.
examples.zh: 他们不得不同各种困境斗争。

phrases.translation: 登广告征求（寻找）某物；登招请（待聘等）广告

examples.en: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
examples.zh: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

examples.en: Colleges and universities have found that it pays to advertise (=  advertising brings good results  ) .
examples.zh: 大专院校发现做广告效果很好。

examples.en: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News', offering a high salary for the right person.
examples.zh: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

examples.en: The organizers of the concert had taken out a full page advertisement in ‘The New York Times'.
examples.zh: 音乐会筹办者在《纽约时报》上刊登了整版广告。

examples.en: Only a handful of people answered the advertisement .
examples.zh: 只有寥寥数人对该广告作出了回应。

examples.en: You should have followed my advice.
examples.zh: 你真该听我的建议。

examples.en: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
examples.zh: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

examples.en: Don't keep asking me for advice. Use your initiative.
examples.zh: 别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。

examples.en: I deem it advisable to buy property now.
examples.zh: 我认为现在购置房地产是明智的。

examples.en: It would't be advisable for us to kiss off their objections.
examples.zh: 对人家的意见不予理睬是不明智的。

translations: 建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告

examples.en: She needed someone to advise her.
examples.zh: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

examples.en: ‘Make sure that you keep the documents in a safe place,' Otley advised him.
examples.zh: “一定要把文件放在安全的地方。”奥特利向他建议道。

examples.en: He assembled a panel of scholars to advise him.
examples.zh: 他集结了一个学者小组为他出谋划策。

phrases.translation: 咨询委员会；顾问委员会

examples.en: The State Department issues travel advisories about conditions overseas.
examples.zh: 国务院就海外局势发布旅游警报。

phrases.translation: 故意持相反意见的人；故意唱反调的人

examples.en: Mr. Williams is a conservative who advocates fewer government controls on business.
examples.zh: 威廉斯先生是一位提倡减少政府对商业的控制的保守人士。

examples.en: Extremists were openly advocating violence.
examples.zh: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

examples.en: The aeroplane landed us at the airport in Barcelona.
examples.zh: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

translations: 事情；事务；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事

examples.en: Are you interested in world affairs?
examples.zh: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

examples.en: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
examples.zh: 外交部

examples.en: Women had little role in public affairs.
examples.zh: 女性过去几乎不参与公共事务。

examples.en: the areas affected by the hurricane
examples.zh: 受飓风影响的地区

examples.en: a disease that affects the central nervous system
examples.zh: 影响中枢神经系统的疾病

examples.en: decisions which affect our lives
examples.zh: 影响我们生活的决定

examples.en: She looked back on those days with affection .
examples.zh: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

examples.en: Their father never showed them much affection .
examples.zh: 他们的父亲对他们从来没有表现出多少慈爱。

examples.en: The church was held in great affection (=  loved and cared about a lot  ) by the local residents.
examples.zh: 教会深受当地民众爱戴。

examples.en: an affectionate hug
examples.zh: 亲切的拥抱

examples.en: The general affirmed rumors of an attack.
examples.zh: 将军证实了袭击的传闻。

roots.meaning: 向/到(ad- 同化, f 前)

examples.en: On the other hand, when he/she is being positive, reply in affirmation and enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 另一方面，当他处于积极状态时，要用肯定和热情的话语来答复。

examples.zh: 但是当你已经知道是否向前推进或彻底放弃的时候，你需要的是一个肯定。

examples.en: On the other hand, when he/she is being positive, reply in affirmation and enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 另一方面，如果他/她正处于积极状态，给予肯定积极的答复。

examples.en: I couldn't afford the rent on my own.
examples.zh: 我单靠自己付不起房租。

examples.en: How can she afford to eat out every night?

examples.zh: 他一脸的震惊，接着便放声大笑起来。

examples.zh: 除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

examples.zh: 为了筹集15万美元，该组织发起了一场募捐活动。

examples.zh: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

examples.zh: 现在大多数人都喜欢工作时间短些，闲暇时间多些。

examples.en: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
examples.zh: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

examples.en: our planet's precious resources
examples.zh: 我们星球上的宝贵资源

examples.en: They traded in gold and other precious metals (= valuable metals used especially for making jewellery ) .
examples.zh: 他们做黄金和其他贵金属的交易。

examples.en: precise sales figures
examples.zh: 准确的销售数据

examples.en: It was difficult to get precise information.
examples.zh: 很难得到确切的消息。

examples.en: ‘She's a lot older than you, isn't she?' ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .'
examples.zh: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

phrases.translation: 精密加工；精密机械加工

examples.en: The lenses are ground to a high standard of precision.
examples.zh: 镜片被磨到很高的精确度。

examples.en: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
examples.zh: 销售额比预期低5%。

examples.en: As Liz had predicted , the rumours were soon forgotten.
examples.zh: 正如利兹所预料的，流言很快就被淡忘了。

examples.en: It's practically impossible to predict what will happen.
examples.zh: 将会发生什么，几乎不能预料。

examples.en: ...the preface to Kelman's novel.
examples.zh: …凯尔曼小说的前言。

phrases.translation: 宁可做某事；更喜欢做某事

examples.en: This type of owl prefers a desert habitat.
examples.zh: 这种猫头鹰更喜欢沙漠的生活环境。

examples.en: She prefers her coffee black.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢喝黑咖啡。

examples.en: the government's preferred option
examples.zh: 政府倾向的选择

examples.en: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
examples.zh: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

examples.en: In warm weather, clothes made of natural fabrics are infinitely preferable (= much better ) .
examples.zh: 天气暖和的时候，穿天然织物的衣服要舒适得多。

examples.en: Do you have a colour preference ?
examples.zh: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

examples.en: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
examples.zh: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

examples.en: The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
examples.zh: 加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。

examples.en: Heterosexuals should not be treated preferentially when the state carries out that role.
examples.zh: 当国家执行这个作用的时候不应该优先对待异性恋者。

examples.en: Then back in Spain, they trained a strain of Pseudomonas bacteria to preferentially nibble salt blooms.
examples.zh: 回到西班牙后，他们便培养了一种可以优先吞食盐层的假单胞菌。

examples.en: "We try to find which parts of the brain preferentially talk to which other parts, " he says. "We can sort of map that out, and at the end it sort of spits out a number.
examples.zh: “我们希望弄明白大脑中哪些部分优先和哪些部分通信”他说“我们可以从某种程度上将其映射出来，并最终以数字的方式反映出来，这就是“脑龄””。

examples.en: care for pregnant women
examples.zh: 孕妇保健

examples.en: I knew right away that I was pregnant.
examples.zh: 我立即明白我怀孕了。

examples.en: I thought I was too old to get pregnant .
examples.zh: 我觉得自己年龄太大，已经不能怀孕了。

examples.en: Women still face prejudice in the workplace.
examples.zh: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

examples.en: It takes a long time to overcome these kinds of prejudices.
examples.zh: 战胜这些偏见需要假以时日。

examples.en: This part of the community needs to be protected from racial prejudice .
examples.zh: 需保护社区里的这一部分人，使其免受种族偏见的伤害。

phrases.translation: 初始阶段，初期；原始阶段

examples.en: the preliminary stages of the competition
examples.zh: 竞赛的预赛阶段

examples.en: a preliminary draft
examples.zh: 初稿

examples.en: one of Dublin's premier hotels
examples.zh: 都柏林最好的酒店之一

examples.en: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
examples.zh: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

examples.en: Plans for the new school are now in preparation .
examples.zh: 新学校的设计图正在绘制中。

examples.en: a course in food service and food preparation
examples.zh: 餐饮服务和备菜课程

examples.en: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
examples.zh: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

examples.en: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
examples.zh: 在语法规则中没有哪一条表明以介词结束一个句子是错误的。

examples.en: The physician examines the patient then diagnoses the disease and prescribes medication.
examples.zh: 内科医生检查了病人，然后对疾病作出诊断，并开出药方。

phrases.translation: 须医师处方才可买的药品

examples.en: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .
examples.zh: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

examples.en: a repeat prescription
examples.zh: 重复处方

examples.en: Your presence is requested at the club meeting on Friday.
examples.zh: 敬请出席于周五举行的俱乐部会议。

examples.en: His presence should fill the power vacuum that has been developing over the past few days.
examples.zh: 他的出现应该能填补过去几天中形成的权力空缺。

examples.en: She was barely aware of his presence.
examples.zh: 她几乎没有注意到他的存在。

examples.en: the present situation of the millions of people who are suffering poverty and disease
examples.zh: 遭受贫困和疾病折磨的数百万人民的现状

examples.en: She was presented with an award .
examples.zh: 她被授予一个奖项。

examples.en: Doctors strongly recommend that fathers should be present at their baby's birth.
examples.zh: 医生极力建议孩子出生时父亲应该在场。

translations: 展示；描述，陈述；介绍；赠送

phrases.translation: 口头报告；口头陈述；口头演讲
n. 演讲技巧；表达技巧

examples.en: We will begin a series of presentations to help the public fully understand our system.
examples.zh: 我们将进行一系列的说明，帮助公众充分了解我们的制度。

examples.en: 40 of her colleagues gathered for her farewell presentation.
examples.zh: 40位同事来参加了她的欢送会。

examples.en: The doctor will be here presently.
examples.zh: 医生一会儿就到。

examples.en: Presently, I fell asleep.
examples.zh: 一会儿我就睡着了。

examples.en: the present situation of the millions of people who are suffering poverty and disease
examples.zh: 遭受贫困和疾病折磨的数百万人民的现状

examples.en: methods of food preservation
examples.zh: 保存食物的各种方法

translations: 保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品

examples.en: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
examples.zh: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

examples.en: Motor-racing has largely been a male preserve (= something that only men have been involved with ) .
examples.zh: 赛车基本上是男人的专利。

examples.en: the need to preserve the planet for future generations
examples.zh: 为子孙后代保护地球的必要性

examples.en: President Bush
examples.zh: 布什总统

examples.en: The president himself won the most votes.
examples.zh: 总统本人赢得了最多的选票。

examples.en: The president begins talks with the prime minister tonight.
examples.zh: 总统将于今晚和首相展开会谈。

translations: 压；按；新闻；出版社；[印刷] 印刷机

phrases.translation: 记者招待会，新闻发布会

examples.en: Manville kept his back pressed flat against the wall.
examples.zh: 曼维尔后背紧紧地贴在墙上。

examples.en: She pressed the gas pedal and the car leapt forwards.
examples.zh: 她踩下油门，汽车向前冲了出去。

examples.en: He pressed a card into her hand before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开之前他往她手里塞了一张卡片。

phrases.translation: 面临压力，在压力之下；受到压力

examples.en: They are putting pressure on people to vote yes.
examples.zh: 他们正在向民众施加压力，要求他们投赞成票。

examples.en: You must never give in to pressure .
examples.zh: 你绝不能屈从压力。

examples.en: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
examples.zh: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

examples.en: Let's pretend we're on the moon.
examples.zh: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

examples.en: He's not asleep – he's just pretending.
examples.zh: 他并没睡着，不过是装睡而已。

examples.en: To pretend ignorance of the situation would be irresponsible.
examples.zh: 装作不知情是不负责任的做法。

translations: 有吸引力的事物（尤指饰品）；漂亮的人

examples.en: a pretty little girl
examples.zh: 漂亮的小姑娘

examples.en: Maria looks much prettier with her hair cut short.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚把头发剪短好看多了。

examples.en: I left my keys at home, which was a pretty silly thing to do .
examples.zh: 我干了件傻事，把钥匙落在家里了。

examples.en: A similar situation prevails in Canada.
examples.zh: 同样的情况在加拿大也普遍存在。

examples.en: Justice will prevail.
examples.zh: 正义终将获胜。

phrases.translation: 防治污染；预防和控制污染

examples.en: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
examples.zh: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

examples.en: We were prevented from entering the site.
examples.zh: 我们被阻止进入现场。

examples.en: Wrap small ornaments in paper to prevent them being damaged.
examples.zh: 把小饰品用纸包上以免损坏。

examples.en: Forty thousand children a day die from preventable diseases.
examples.zh: 每天有四万儿童死于本可以防止的疾病。

phrases.translation: 影片未公开宣布的预演；内部预映；试映

examples.en: the press preview of the show (= when people who write for newspapers, television etc could see it )
examples.zh: 该节目的媒体试映

phrases.translation: 上一页，前一页；返回上一级菜单
（国会议事程序中作为动议提出的）先决问题

examples.en: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage.
examples.zh: 她有个出自前一次婚姻的十几岁的女儿。

examples.en: She has three daughters from a previous marriage.
examples.zh: 她前一次婚姻生了三个女儿。

examples.en: Guyana's railways were previously owned by private companies.
examples.zh: 圭亚那的铁路先前为私营公司所拥有。

examples.en: The contract was awarded to a previously unknown company.
examples.zh: 该合同给了一家先前不知名的公司。

examples.en: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage.
examples.zh: 她有个出自前一次婚姻的十几岁的女儿。

phrases.translation: 竞争价格；公开招标价格

examples.en: They may pay a high price for their few years of glory.
examples.zh: 为了短短几年的辉煌，他们也许要付出高昂的代价。

examples.en: Write down the following information: name of product, type, date purchased and price.
examples.zh: 写下以下信息：产品名称、型号、购买日期和价格。

examples.en: Does the price include postage?
examples.zh: 这个价格包含邮费吗？

phrases.translation: 头等重要的位置；首要地位；傲慢

examples.en: He wore his medals with pride.
examples.zh: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

examples.en: The people have a sense of pride in their community.
examples.zh: 人们对自己的社区有一种自豪感。

examples.en: His heart swelled with pride when his daughter came in.
examples.zh: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

examples.en: The advertisement is aimed primarily at children.
examples.zh: 这则广告的对象主要是儿童。

phrases.translation: 主因子，准素因子；一次因素

examples.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

examples.en: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
examples.zh: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

examples.en: Personal safety is of primary importance .
examples.zh: 人身安全至关重要。

examples.en: a primary teacher
examples.zh: 一名小学老师

examples.en: primary education
examples.zh: 小学教育

examples.en: teaching at primary level
examples.zh: 小学程度教学

examples.en: Smoking is the prime cause of lung disease.
examples.zh: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

examples.en: Our prime concern is providing jobs for all young school leavers.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是为所有的年轻毕业生提供工作。

examples.en: He was named as the prime suspect in the murder investigation.
examples.zh: 在那宗谋杀案的调查中他被定为主要嫌疑人。

translations: 原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的

examples.en: a primitive society
examples.zh: 原始社会

examples.en: a primitive nomadic tribe
examples.zh: 原始的游牧部落

examples.en: the tools used by primitive man
examples.zh: 原始人所用的工具

phrases.translation: n. 威尔士亲王（英国皇太子之封号）

examples.en: Prince William
examples.zh: 威廉王子

examples.en: The Crown Prince was Japan's most eligible bachelor (=  a rich young man who has not yet married  ) .
examples.zh: 皇太子是日本最理想的适婚男子。

examples.en: So she married the prince, and they lived happily ever after (= used at the end of children's stories to say that someone was happy for the rest of their life ).
examples.zh: 她嫁给了王子，他们从此过着幸福的生活。

phrases.translation: n. 将继承王位的公主；女王储
小公主（原著为小说，后多次改编为电影、电视剧和动画）
幽灵公主；魔法公主（动画电影）

examples.en: Princess Anne
examples.zh: 安妮公主

examples.en: The official opening ceremony was performed by Princess Margaret.
examples.zh: 官方开幕式由玛 格丽特公主主持。

examples.en: His principal reason for making the journey was to visit his family.
examples.zh: 他那次旅程的首要目的是探访家人。

examples.en: Teaching is her principal source of income.
examples.zh: 教书是她主要的收入来源。

examples.en: the principal character in the book
examples.zh: 书里的主人公

translations: 原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉

examples.en: Schools try to teach children a set of principles.
examples.zh: 学校设法教给孩子们一套道德准则。

examples.en: He's got no principles at all!
examples.zh: 他毫无道德准则！

examples.en: It's against my principles to accept gifts from clients.
examples.zh: 收受客户礼物违背我的原则。

examples.en: The general principle is that education should be available to all children up to the age of 16.
examples.zh: 总的原则是，16 岁以下儿童都应该能接受教育。

examples.en: He called for a return to first principles (= the most important ideas ) of road safety for children.
examples.zh: 他呼吁回归儿童道路安全的根本原则。

examples.en: Similar principles apply in the case of older children (= the principles are the same as others that have been mentioned ) .
examples.zh: 类似的原则也适用于年纪大些的儿童。

translations: 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记
印刷；打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样

phrases.translation: （契约中）难懂的条文；极小的字体

examples.en: Over five million copies of the paper are printed every day.
examples.zh: 这份报纸每日印量超过五百万。

examples.en: When the book was first written no publisher would print it.
examples.zh: 这本书刚写成时没有出版商愿意出版。

examples.en: There was no print at all on the backs of the tickets.
examples.zh: 门票背面没有印任何文字。

examples.en: the pleasure of seeing my name in print
examples.zh: 在出版物中看到我名字时的那份喜悦

examples.en: Very little of his poetry actually got into print (= was printed ) .
examples.zh: 他的诗作鲜有付梓。

phrases.translation: 喷墨式打印机；喷墨印表机
喷墨打印机（通常连接在电脑系统上）

examples.en: a laser printer
examples.zh: 激光打印机

examples.en: a colour printer
examples.zh: 彩色打印机

examples.en: Reverse the paper in the printer.
examples.zh: 把打印机中的纸翻过来。

examples.en: the invention of printing
examples.zh: 印刷术的发明

examples.en: the printing industry
examples.zh: 印刷业

examples.en: a printing error
examples.zh: 印刷错误

phrases.translation: 事先批准；预先审批；事前批准；事前许可；预先核准

examples.en: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
examples.zh: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

examples.en: Changes may not be made without the prior approval of the council.
examples.zh: 未经委员会事先同意，不得作出改变。

examples.en: Vegetarian meals are provided by prior agreement.
examples.zh: 经事先协商可提供素食。

examples.en: The club's priority is to win the League.
examples.zh: 该俱乐部首先考虑的是要赢得联赛。

examples.en: After several burglaries in the area, security is now a high priority (= very important and needing attention soon ) .
examples.zh: 该地区发生了几宗入室盗窃案以后，治安成了当务之急。

examples.en: With so little money available, repairs must remain a low priority (= not important and not needing attention soon ) .
examples.zh: 可用的钱这么少，只好暂时放下维修事宜了。

examples.en: He visits his dad in prison every week.
examples.zh: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

examples.en: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.
examples.zh: 里基现已出狱三年。

examples.en: They'll probably put him in prison for a long time.
examples.zh: 他们很可能会让他在监狱里待很长时间。

translations: 囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告

examples.en: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
examples.zh: 狱警和犯人相处良好。

examples.en: Prisoners here only serve short sentences.
examples.zh: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

examples.en: The organization is arguing for the release of political prisoners (= people in prison because of their political opinions ) .
examples.zh: 该组织正在争取释放政治犯。

examples.en: each individual's right to privacy
examples.zh: 每个人的隐私权

examples.en: Shelley valued her privacy.
examples.zh: 谢利很重视自己的隐私。

examples.en: People here like their freedom and privacy.
examples.zh: 这里的人喜欢他们所拥有的自由与隐私权。

examples.en: Morris has a private jet.
examples.zh: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

examples.en: He made some notes for his private use.
examples.zh: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

examples.en: They objected to any form of private property .
examples.zh: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

phrases.translation: 特权；特别优惠；特殊许可

examples.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
examples.zh: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

examples.en: In this month's competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
examples.zh: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

examples.en: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.
examples.zh: 获得一等奖的是约翰·金特尔博士。

examples.en: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
examples.zh: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

phrases.translation: 机率密度函数；概率密度分布函数

examples.en: You must decide whether, on the balance of probabilities , he committed the crime.
examples.zh: 你们一定要权衡正反两方面的可能性，然后再裁定他是否犯罪。

translations: 很可能的事；大有希望的候选者

phrases.translation: 可能的原因；合理的根据
概差；概然误差；可能错误

examples.en: The probable cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
examples.zh: 起火的原因很可能是电路故障。

examples.en: Success is highly probable .
examples.zh: 成功的希望相当大。

examples.en: She will probably be scarred for life .
examples.zh: 她有可能留下永久的疤痕。

examples.en: Campbell's broken leg will probably require surgery.
examples.zh: 坎贝尔的一条腿骨折，可能需要手术。

examples.en: This idea probably won't work, but let's try it anyway.
examples.zh: 这个办法可能行不通，不过我们还是试试吧。

examples.en: She was older than me, but that wasn't really a problem.
examples.zh: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

examples.en: There is a major problem with parking in London.
examples.zh: 在伦敦，停车是个很大的问题。

examples.en: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

phrases.translation: 民事诉讼；民事诉讼法；民事诉讼程序

examples.en: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
examples.zh: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

examples.en: He carefully explained the procedure.

phrases.translation: [美国英语]以及返程，打个来回

examples.en: Can you repeat your question?
examples.zh: 你能重复一遍你的问题吗？

examples.en: Sorry - could you repeat that?
examples.zh: 对不起——你能再说一遍吗？

examples.zh: 那不是我的错，我再说一遍，不是。

examples.zh: 这套操每天做两次。

examples.zh: 我们不能再犯以前的错误。

examples.en: The team are hoping to repeat their success (= achieve the same good result ) of last season.
examples.zh: 球队希望再续上一赛季的佳绩。

examples.en: Graham was repeatedly warned not to work so hard.
examples.zh: 格雷厄姆一再被提醒工作不要这么拼命。

examples.en: Nature is a recurrent theme (= a theme that appears repeatedly ) in Frost's poetry.
examples.zh: 大自然是弗罗斯特诗作中反复出现的一个主题。

examples.en: The new law will ensure that habitual criminals (= criminals who commit crimes repeatedly ) receive tougher punishments than first-time offenders.
examples.zh: 新法律将确保惯犯比初犯受到更为严厉的惩罚。

examples.en: Children used to learn by repetition.
examples.zh: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

examples.en: Repetition can help the learning process.
examples.zh: 重复对学习过程会有帮助。

translations: 取代，代替；替换，更换；归还，偿还；把…放回原处

examples.en: I'm replacing Sue on the team.
examples.zh: 我将接替队里的休。

examples.en: Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
examples.zh: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

examples.en: AOP does not replace existing programming paradigms and languages; instead, it works with them to improve their expressiveness and utility.
examples.zh: AOP并不 替换现存的程序范例或语言，而是 与 它们协同工作以提高他们的表达能力与效用。

examples.en: Our old car is badly in need of replacement.
examples.zh: 我们的旧车急需更换。

examples.en: replacement windows
examples.zh: 新换的窗户

examples.en: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
examples.zh: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

examples.en: I asked Clive where he was going, but he didn't reply.
examples.zh: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

examples.zh: 抱歉，我过了这么久才回复。

examples.en: ‘Did you see Simon today?' ‘Of course,' Nathalie replied with a smile.
examples.zh: “你今天见到西蒙了吗？”“当然啦。”纳萨莉笑着答道。

phrases.translation: 年报，年度报告；年度决算；年度财务报告

examples.en: This is Gavin Williams, reporting from the United Nations in New York.
examples.zh: 我是加文·威廉斯，在纽约联合国总部为您报道。

examples.en: We aim to report the news as fairly as possible.
examples.zh: 我们力求公正地报道这一新闻。

examples.en: The incident was widely reported in the national press.
examples.zh: 这一事件在全国的媒体上被广泛报道。

examples.en: According to recent news reports , two of the victims are Americans.
examples.zh: 根据近期的新闻报道，受害者中有两名是美国人。

examples.en: a news reporter
examples.zh: 新闻记者

translations: 代表；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送

examples.en: Mr Kobayashi was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
examples.zh: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

examples.en: Women now represent almost 50% of the workforce.
examples.zh: 如今女性几乎占全部劳动人口的 50%。

examples.en: a union representative
examples.zh: 工会代表

examples.zh: 民意调查员向一些有代表性的纽约居民征询了意见。

examples.zh: 这本精美的书里翻印了克里木特的艺术作品。

examples.en: The turtles return to the coast to reproduce.
examples.zh: 海龟回到岸上繁殖。

examples.zh: 额外使用激素使得这些动物的生殖器官比正常情况下发育得更快。

examples.zh: 他们有可能积极地回应该总统的援助请求。

examples.zh: 他的第一反应是不相信。

examples.zh: 埃米特的新展览得到评论家的好评。

examples.zh: 我们有责任帮助难民，这一事实无法改变。

examples.zh: 我们决意要将肇事者绳之以法。

examples.zh: 出现任何差错的话，我唯你是问。

examples.zh: 如果你累了，我们就停下来歇一会儿。

examples.zh: 马克的数学成绩总是落在班上其他同学后面。

examples.zh: 他带她到一家豪华餐厅吃了一顿有五道菜的晚餐。

examples.zh: 在马赛住了几星期后，我开始待不住了，决定换个地方。

examples.zh: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

examples.zh: 暴乱爆发后，国民警卫队被调来恢复秩序。

phrases.translation: adv. 因此，由于；作为…的结果

examples.zh: 将种子培育成植株，有时会产生令人失望的结果。

examples.zh: 你有权保留这些物品。

examples.zh: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

examples.zh: 我真希望那时我就知道现在所知道的一切。

examples.en: It was then that I realised she'd tricked me.
examples.zh: 直到那时我才知道她骗了我。

examples.en: He started his career in St Petersburg – or Leningrad as it then was.
examples.zh: 他在圣彼得堡——当时叫列宁格勒——开始他的事业。

translations: 理论的；理论上的；假设的；推理的

examples.en: theoretical physics
examples.zh: 理论物理

examples.en: Aristotle's theoretical model of the universe
examples.zh: 亚里士多德有关宇宙的理论模型

examples.en: She has theoretical knowledge of teaching, but no practical experience.
examples.zh: 她有教学方面的理论知识，但没有实际经验。

examples.en: Freudian theory has had a great influence on psychology.
examples.zh: 弗洛伊德理论对心理学产生过巨大影响。

examples.en: the theory of evolution
examples.zh: 进化论

examples.en: In Freud's theory, the two areas of sexuality and violence are interconnected.
examples.zh: 按照弗洛伊德的理论，性和暴力这两个方面是相互关联的。

examples.en: new drug therapies
examples.zh: 新的药物疗法

examples.en: radiation therapy for cancer treatment
examples.zh: 治疗癌症的放射疗法

translations: 在那里；在那边；在那点上

phrases.translation: 到达那里；取得成功，实现目标

examples.en: We could go back to my cottage and have lunch there.
examples.zh: 我们可以回到我的小屋去吃午饭。

examples.en: Scotland? I've always wanted to go there.
examples.zh: 苏格兰？我一直想去那儿。

examples.en: Hold it right there and don't move.
examples.zh: 就站在那里，不要动。

examples.en: Our bodies can sweat, thereby losing heat by evaporation.
examples.zh: 我们的身体会流汗，由此能通过蒸发散热。

examples.en: Their car was bigger and therefore more comfortable.
examples.zh: 他们的车大些，所以更舒适些。

examples.en: Progress so far has been very good. We are, therefore, confident that the work will be completed on time.
examples.zh: 到目前为止进展十分顺利，所以我们有把握按时完成工作。

examples.en: You know nothing about her really, or about yourself in relation to her, and anyhow it's only one of those things and therefore it's of no importance.
examples.zh: 你对她一点儿都不了解，也不了解自己和她的关系，无论如何它只是那些事情之一,因此没有任何重要性。

phrases.translation: 红外测温仪；红外线温度计

examples.en: The thermometer registered over 100˚C.
examples.zh: 温度计显示高于100摄氏度。

examples.en: This thermometer is calibrated by centigrade.
examples.zh: 这种温度计是用摄氏百分度标定的。

examples.en: I am the system. I could be a system It could be a hot coffee in a thermos.
examples.zh: 我就是系统，我可以是个系统,它可以是热水瓶里的热咖啡。

examples.en: Choose to take a thermos or travel mug with you when you get your morning coffee instead of using a disposable cup.
examples.zh: 准备早餐咖啡时使用热水瓶或汽车杯取代一次性杯子。

examples.en: We all defer to her in these matters.
examples.zh: 在这些事情上我们都听她的。

examples.en: Are these all yours?
examples.zh: 这些都是你的吗?

examples.en: Bear these thoughts with you as you go out into the world.
examples.zh: 当你出去走入社会时你把这些思想牢记在心。

examples.en: Bob and Sue said they wouldn't be able to come.
examples.zh: 鲍勃和休说他们来不了。

examples.en: Ken gave me some flowers. Aren't they beautiful?
examples.zh: 肯送给我一些花。很漂亮吧？

examples.en: They all want to come to the wedding.
examples.zh: 他们都想来参加婚礼。

translations: 最拥挤部分；活动最多部分；事物的粗大浓密部分

phrases.translation: 不畏艰险；在任何情况下

examples.en: Brown hopes to be back in the thick of the action as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 布朗希望尽快回去，参与到最紧要的行动中。

examples.en: roast pork and apple sauce (=  a thick sauce made from cooked apples  )
examples.zh: 烤猪肉配苹果酱汁

examples.en: The house was still burning, pouring forth thick black smoke.
examples.zh: 房子仍在燃烧，冒出浓浓的黑烟。

phrases.translation: 板块厚度；筛板厚度；金属板厚度

examples.en: The thickness of the walls is 5 feet.
examples.zh: 墙体厚度为5英尺。

examples.en: The screen is now flush with the case and we've decreased the overall thickness to about 18 mm.
examples.zh: 现在的屏幕已经和外壳在同一平面上，而且我们已经将总厚度压缩到18毫米。

examples.en: Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000's worth of computer equipment.
examples.zh: 小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15万美元的电脑设备。

examples.en: They were nothing but petty thieves (= thieves who steal small things ) .
examples.zh: 他们只不过是小毛贼。

examples.en: Police will have the pictures enlarged in an attempt to identify the thief.
examples.zh: 为了确认窃贼的身份，警方会将这些照片放大。

translations: 薄的；瘦的；稀薄的；微弱的

phrases.translation: 不畏艰险；在任何情况下

examples.en: a thin gold chain
examples.zh: 一条细细的金链

examples.en: She's only wearing a thin summer jacket (= a jacket made of light material ) .
examples.zh: 她只穿了一件薄薄的夏装外套。

examples.en: two thin slices of bread
examples.zh: 薄薄的两片面包

phrases.translation: 好东西，好事情；美好的事
第一件事；一大早；最重要的事情

examples.en: People say things they don't mean when they are angry.
examples.zh: 人生气时就会口不择言。

examples.en: It was a horrible thing to happen.
examples.zh: 发生这样的事情太糟糕了。

examples.en: I plan to do all the things I've been meaning to do for ages.
examples.zh: 我打算去做我多年以来一直想做的事。

phrases.translation: 自命不凡,自以为了不起[亦作 think oneself something]
记起，想起；考虑；想像；关心

examples.en: I thought I heard something.
examples.zh: 我觉得我听到了什么声音。

examples.en: He didn't think anyone would believe him.
examples.zh: 他觉得没人会相信他。

examples.en: Do you think I should call him?
examples.zh: 你认为我应该打电话给他吗？

translations: 思考的；思想的；有理性的；好思考的
思考；思想；想法；意见；见解

phrases.translation: 批判性思维，批判性的思考；批判思考能力，判断思维

examples.en: the thinking man's pop band
examples.zh: 有思想的男士喜欢的流行乐队

examples.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
examples.zh: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

examples.en: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
examples.zh: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

phrases.translation: 第三人称；第三人称时使用之代名词与动词

examples.en: Divide it into thirds.
examples.zh: 把它分成三等份。

examples.en: We might have a third child, but that's the absolute maximum .
examples.zh: 我们可能会要第三个孩子，但这绝对是极限了。

examples.en: ‘Where's your office?' ‘It's on the third floor.'
examples.zh: “你的办公室在哪儿？”“在三楼。”

examples.en: Ice water is the only thing that really quenches my thirst (= gets rid of it ) .
examples.zh: 只有冰水才能让我真正解渴。

examples.en: We had worked up a thirst (= done something that made us thirsty ) ，and so we decided to stop for a beer.
examples.zh: 我们干得口渴了，因此决定停下来喝杯啤酒。

examples.en: Maggie woke up with a raging thirst (= an extremely strong thirst ) .
examples.zh: 玛吉醒来时感到口干舌燥。

translations: 口渴的，口干的；渴望的，热望的

examples.en: Can I have a glass of water? I'm really thirsty.
examples.zh: 我能喝一杯水吗？ 我太渴了。

examples.en: He'd been working in the garden and was very hot and thirsty.
examples.zh: 他一直在花园里干活，又热又渴。

examples.en: All this digging is thirsty work (= work that makes you want a drink ) .
examples.zh: 这种挖地的活干了让人口渴。

examples.en: They've only sold thirteen tickets so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止他们仅仅售出13张票。

examples.en: When it happened, I was thirteen (= 13 years old ) .
examples.zh: 那事发生时，我13岁。

examples.en: In the thirties, air travel really began to take off.
examples.zh: 在30年代，乘飞机旅行迅速流行了起来。

examples.en: Thirty people died in a fire in downtown Chicago.
examples.zh: 30人死于芝加哥市中心的一场火灾。

examples.en: A cup of rice which cost thirty cents a few weeks ago is now being sold for up to one dollar.
examples.zh: 几周前价值30美分的1杯米如今卖到了1美元。

examples.en: The table's about this high and this wide.
examples.zh: 那桌子大约有这么高，这么宽。

examples.en: You need to cut about this much off the end of the pipe.
examples.zh: 你要从管子头上切下大约这么多。

examples.en: Can you help me hang this painting (= put it on a wall ) ?
examples.zh: 你帮我把这幅画挂起来好吗？

examples.en: The doctor gave him a thorough check-up.
examples.zh: 医生给他做了一次全面的体检。

examples.en: a thorough and detailed biography
examples.zh: 详尽的传记

examples.en: The police investigation was very thorough.
examples.zh: 警方的调查十分彻底。

examples.en: He dotted down those notes.
examples.zh: 他匆匆记下了那些注解。

examples.en: She ganged up on me with those rough boys.
examples.zh: 她伙同那些粗野的男孩对付我。

examples.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
examples.zh: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

phrases.translation: 走过；排练；经历；从头到尾地阅读

examples.en: Two heart attacks in a year. It hasn't stopped him smoking, though.
examples.zh: 一年里心脏病发作了两次，可是那也没让他把烟戒掉。

examples.en: It sounds like a lot of fun. Isn't it rather risky though?
examples.zh: 听上去很有趣。可是这不是也很危险吗？

examples.en: I believed him, even though his story sounded unlikely.
examples.zh: 我相信了他，尽管他的话听上去难以置信。

translations: 想，思考；认为（think的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: It's an interesting thought.
examples.zh: 这想法很有趣。

examples.en: The thought that I might not have a job next year is a bit troubling.
examples.zh: 想到明年可能失业我有点心烦。

examples.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
examples.zh: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

examples.en: Paul is very thoughtful.
examples.zh: 保罗非常体贴人。

examples.en: a journey of almost a thousand miles
examples.zh: 将近1,000英里的旅程

examples.en: There are more than two thousand of us, not counting the crew.
examples.zh: 我们有两千多人，不包括工作人员在内。

examples.en: They spent over a thousand pounds.
examples.zh: 他们花了一千多英镑。

translations: 线；螺纹；思路；衣服；线状物；玻璃纤维；路线

phrases.translation: 螺纹切削；螺纹车削；车削螺纹

examples.en: I'm looking for a needle and thread.
examples.zh: 我在找针线。

examples.en: hand-sewn with gold and silver thread
examples.zh: 用金线和银线手工缝制的

examples.en: a spool of thread (= small object that thread is wound around )
examples.zh: 一卷线

phrases.translation: 构成威胁；形成一种威胁
保安巡逻，对安全的威胁；安全感胁
紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁

examples.en: Your threats don't scare me.
examples.zh: 你的那些威胁吓不倒我。

examples.en: threats made against his wife and children
examples.zh: 对他妻儿的威胁

examples.en: Nichols never carried out his threat to resign.
examples.zh: 尼科尔斯威胁过要辞职，但从未付诸行动。

examples.en: Postal workers are threatening a strike if they don't receive a pay increase.
examples.zh: 邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

examples.en: The government's political and economic reforms threaten to plunge the country into chaos.
examples.zh: 该政府的政治和经济改革有可能使这个国家陷入混乱之中。

examples.en: They've won their last three games.
examples.zh: 他们赢了最近三场比赛。

examples.en: We'd better go. It's almost three (= three o'clock ) .
examples.zh: 我们该走了。快3点了。

examples.en: My little sister's only three (= three years old ) .
examples.zh: 我的小妹妹只有3岁。

translations: 使…颤动；使…紧张；使…感到兴奋或激动

examples.en: Winning first place must have been quite a thrill.
examples.zh: 赢得第一名肯定让人非常激动。

examples.en: Even though I've been acting for years, I still get a thrill out of going on stage.
examples.zh: 尽管我演了多年戏，走上舞台我仍然感到十分激动。

examples.en: It gave Pat a thrill to finally see the group perform live.
examples.zh: 帕特终于看到这个乐队现场表演，感到十分激动。

translations: 惊险小说；使人毛骨悚然的东西；使人毛骨悚然的小说

examples.en: ...a tense psychological thriller.
examples.zh: …一部紧张刺激的心理惊悚小说。

examples.en: plants that thrive in tropical rain forests
examples.zh: 在热带雨林蓬勃生长的植物

examples.en: a business which managed to thrive during a recession
examples.zh: 在经济萧条时期也能顺利发展的一家企业

examples.en: The singer complained of a sore throat after Wednesday's show.
examples.zh: 星期三演出后，这位歌手说喉咙痛。

examples.en: Matthew coughed and cleared his throat.
examples.zh: 马修咳了一声清清喉咙。

examples.en: Symptoms include a sore throat and dry cough.
examples.zh: 症状是喉咙痛和干咳。

phrases.translation: 参加；经受；仔细检查；被通过
一路走过（歌词）；经过所有（歌词）

examples.en: She smiled at him as he walked through the door.
examples.zh: 他从门口进来时，她朝他笑了。

examples.en: Water will be pumped through a pipe.
examples.zh: 水将通过管子抽上来。

examples.en: I managed to squeeze through a gap in the hedge.
examples.zh: 我设法从篱笆上的一个缺口挤了过去。

examples.en: a large organization with offices throughout the world
examples.zh: 在世界各地都设有办事处的一家大型机构

examples.en: The disease spread rapidly throughout Europe.
examples.zh: 疾病迅速在整个欧洲蔓延开来。

examples.en: The house is in excellent condition, with fitted carpets throughout.
examples.zh: 这幢房子状况极好，全部铺着地毯。

examples.en: The first song, "Blue Moon," didn't go too badly except that everyone talked throughout.
examples.zh: 第一首歌《蓝月亮》效果还不算太差，只是所有的人自始至终都在说话。

phrases.translation: v. 扔掉；伸出；说出；否决；突出
扔进；边线发球，掷界外球

examples.en: The bus stopped suddenly and we were all thrown forwards.
examples.zh: 公共汽车猛地停住，我们都往前栽。

examples.en: They thrust him into the back of a jeep.
examples.zh: 他们把他猛推入吉普车的后部。

examples.en: I fended off his sword thrust with my spear.
examples.zh: 他一刀砍来， 我拿枪架住。

examples.en: He thrust his hand into his coat pocket.
examples.zh: 他把手插进大衣口袋里。

examples.en: We were woken in the night by thunder.
examples.zh: 晚上我们被雷声惊醒。

examples.en: My dislike of thunder and even small earthquakes was due to Mother.
examples.zh: 我对雷声甚至于轻微地震的厌恶都归因于我的母亲。

translations: [气象] 雷暴；雷暴雨；大雷雨

examples.en: She was working Thursday.
examples.zh: 她星期四在工作。

examples.en: She gave birth to a baby on Thursday.
examples.zh: 她于星期四产下一名婴儿。

examples.en: There's a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
examples.zh: 星期四下午有个会议。

phrases.translation: 到这种程度为止；这么多

examples.en: Most of the evidence was destroyed in the fire. Thus it would be almost impossible to prove him guilty.
examples.zh: 大多数证据已在大火中烧毁，因而要证明他有罪几乎是不可能的。

phrases.translation: [口语]一会儿，一刹那间，一转眼间

examples.en: The company produces chemicals that destroy ticks and mites.
examples.zh: 该公司生产消灭壁虱和螨虫的化学品。

translations: 票；入场券，标签；（美）候选人名单；证明书；交通罚款单
加标签于；指派；对…开出交通违规罚单

examples.en: How much does it say on the price ticket ?
examples.zh: 价签上标明的价格是多少？

examples.en: Can I see your ticket, please?
examples.zh: 我能看看你的票吗？

examples.en: Your return ticket is valid for three months.
examples.zh: 你的往返票有效期为三个月。

phrases.translation: 低潮；（事物发展的）低落期

examples.en: Strong tides make swimming dangerous.
examples.zh: 遇上大潮时游泳很危险。

examples.en: Is the tide going out or coming in ?
examples.zh: 现在是退潮还是涨潮？

examples.en: We went for a walk and got cut off by the tide .
examples.zh: 我们去散步，结果被潮水困住了。

examples.en: a tidy desk
examples.zh: 整洁的书桌

examples.en: I try to keep the garden tidy .
examples.zh: 我尽量保持花园整洁。

examples.en: Ellen's room is always neat and tidy .
examples.zh: 埃伦的房间总是非常整洁。

translations: 领带；平局；鞋带；领结；不分胜负

phrases.translation: 占用；包扎；绑好；缚牢；阻碍；密切联系；合伙；停泊

examples.en: He tied the ends of the plastic bag together.
examples.zh: 他把塑料袋的两头系在一起。

examples.en: I have to wear a shirt and tie to work.
examples.zh: 我上班要穿衬衫打领带。

examples.en: Harry loosened his tie.
examples.zh: 哈里松开了领带。

phrases.translation: n. 老虎·伍兹（世界著名高尔夫球手）

examples.en: The trainer backed away from the enraged tiger.
examples.zh: 驯兽师从被激怒的老虎身旁往后退。

examples.en: The tiger sprang on the goat.
examples.zh: 老虎向山羊扑去。

translations: 紧的；密封的；绷紧的；麻烦的；严厉的；没空的；吝啬的

phrases.translation: 稳坐不动；坚持主张；静待事态的发展
紧缩的货币政策；紧缩信用政策

examples.en: tight jeans
examples.zh: 紧身牛仔裤

examples.en: My shoes were so tight that I could hardly walk.
examples.zh: 鞋子很紧，我几乎不能走路。

examples.en: The jacket is rather a tight fit (= it fits too tightly ) .
examples.zh: 这件夹克衫太紧了。

phrases.translation: 加强；使紧密；拉紧；使更牢固

examples.en: Fix the frame in position and tighten the screws .
examples.zh: 把框子固定在正确位置上，拧紧螺丝。

examples.en: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
examples.zh: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

translations: [地理][水文] 冰碛；放钱的抽屉；备用现金

examples.en: You keep as much money as you need in the till to run your operations.
examples.zh: 你做业务要储备足够的钱。

examples.en: You'll just have to be patient and wait till I'm off the phone.
examples.zh: 你只能耐心点，等我打完电话。

examples.en: Kay was taught by her mother till she was nine (= nine years old ).
examples.zh: 凯一直由她妈妈教到九岁。

translations: 时间；时代；次数；节拍；倍数
计时；测定…的时间；安排…的速度

examples.en: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

examples.en: close relationships established over a long period of time
examples.zh: 长期建立起来的亲密关系

examples.en: Customers have only a limited amount of time to examine the goods.
examples.zh: 顾客只有有限的时间可以检查商品。

phrases.translation: 课程表；学校作息时间表

examples.en: The timetable was hopelessly optimistic.
examples.zh: 这个时间表过于乐观。

phrases.translation: [美国英语]使用警徽的(指凭此可得到免费用餐等特殊照顾)

examples.en: an old tin bath
examples.zh: 旧的锡浴缸

examples.en: a tiny community in the Midwest
examples.zh: 中西部地区一个极小的社区

examples.en: The earrings were tiny.
examples.zh: 耳环很小。

examples.en: a tiny little baby

examples.zh: 一伙少年

examples.en: The youth was trying to escape the clutches of two drunken female companions.
examples.zh: 那个小伙子试图摆脱两名醉酒女伴的纠缠。

translations: 美味的东西；令人喜爱的东西

examples.en: This cake is really yummy.
examples.zh: 这蛋糕真好吃。

examples.en: ‘Treacle tart! Yummy!' said Simon.
examples.zh: “糖蜜馅饼！ 好吃！”西蒙说。

phrases.translation: [鱼]斑马鱼（一种有斑马条纹的胎生观赏鱼）

examples.en: The neck of the zebra was nipped by a lion.
examples.zh: 狮子咬断了那头斑马的脖子。

examples.en: But what if your horse suddenly grows zebra stripes?
examples.zh: 可是如果那匹马突然长出了斑马的条纹呢？

examples.en: Sixty acres of woods and ponds are home to camels, zebra, bison, water buffalo, ostrich and antelope.
examples.zh: 六十英亩的森林和池塘是骆驼，斑马，野牛，水牛，鸵鸟和羚羊的家园。

examples.en: Make x greater than or equal to zero.
examples.zh: 设x大于或等于零。

examples.en: Ground zero is The Thatch, the village pub joined, via its beer garden, to the even rowdier Billy Budds, rammed to the rafters with sunburnt revellers living the dream.
examples.zh: Thatch酒吧，这家乡村酒馆通过自己的啤酒花园，加入到了吵闹的比利巴德的行列，晒得黝黑、活在梦中的狂欢者的喧哗声充满着整个酒吧。

translations: 拉链；活力，精力；尖啸声，撕裂声；一种程序压缩的档案文件格式
拉开或拉上；以尖啸声行进

phrases.translation: 拉上拉链；增添滋味；增加兴趣或生命力

examples.en: The zip on my skirt had broken.
examples.zh: 我裙子上的拉链坏了。

examples.en: ...the metal zipper on his jacket.
examples.zh: …他的夹克上的金属拉锁。

phrases.translation: 经济特区；经济圈；经济地带

examples.en: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
examples.zh: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。

examples.en: The government has set up a special economic zone to promote private enterprise.
examples.zh: 政府设立了一个经济特区来推动私营企业的发展。

examples.en: The UN will allow the use of force against aircraft violating the zone.
examples.zh: 联合国将允许对侵犯这一地区的飞机采取军事行动。

examples.en: The road to the zoo turns off here.
examples.zh: 通向动物园的路由这儿拐弯。

examples.en: The parrots in the zoo are popping all the time.
examples.zh: 动物园里的鹦鹉一直在生小鹦鹉。

examples.en: Lionesses bearing cubs in the zoo is nothing new now.
examples.zh: 狮子在动物园繁殖早已屡见不鲜了。

translations: 急速上升；嗡嗡声；[摄] 变焦摄影
